description:
About the Opportunity 
 
 Northeastern University is seeking a highly motivated Research Scientist to lead computational modeling efforts investigating the effects of non-ionizing electromagnetic fields on the human nervous system. Working under the direction of Prof. Yarossi, this position will lead the development of realistic head models, tissue segmentation pipelines, and E-field simulations, as well as biophysical neuron modeling. The Research Scientist will collaborate closely with the Northeastern Center for Translational Neuroimaging and will supervise a Research Engineer and graduate student supporting the project. 

 Responsibilities: 

 Lead the creation of realistic head models for E-field simulation, including development of computational modeling pipelines. 
 Conduct numerical simulations of neural activity using point models, cable models, and neural mass models. 
 Implement biophysically realistic, multi-compartment neuron models to estimate electromagnetic field effects on neural tissue. 
 Supervise and mentor the Research Engineer and graduate student on computational modeling tasks. 
 Contribute to technical reporting, manuscript preparation, and dissemination of findings. 
 
 Education/Experience: 

 PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Physics, or a closely related field. 
 Demonstrated experience in computational modeling of electromagnetic fields in biological tissue and/or neuron modeling. 
 
 Skills: 
 Experience with E-field simulation platforms such as SimNIBS, Sim4Life, CST Studio Suite, or ANSYS HFSS. 
 Experience with neuron modeling software such as NEURON, or with neural mass modeling approaches. 
 Strong background in numerical methods, biophysical modeling, and simulation of neural dynamics. 
 Prior experience modeling the effects of electromagnetic fields on biological tissue strongly preferred. 
 Ability to independently lead technical work and mentor junior staff. 
 Strong written and oral communication skills for scientific reporting and publication. 
 
 In compliance with federal government contract requirements, U.S. citizenship is required for this role. Security clearance is not required. 
   
 
 Position Type 
 
Research 
 Additional Information 
 
 Northeastern University considers factors such as candidate work experience, education and skills when extending an offer.  
 
 Northeastern has a comprehensive benefits package for benefit eligible employees. This includes medical, vision, dental, paid time off, tuition assistance, wellness & life, retirement- as well as commuting & transportation. Visit https://hr.northeastern.edu/benefits/ for more information.    
 




 All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
 
 
 
 Compensation Grade/Pay Type: 
109S 
 Expected Hiring Range: 
$67,855.00 - $95,845.00 
 With the pay range(s) shown above, the starting salary will depend on several factors, which may include your education, experience, location, knowledge and expertise, and skills as well as a pay comparison to similarly-situated employees already in the role. Salary ranges are reviewed regularly and are subject to change.
